text: [excited] They tested AI chips... with butter!
[curious] A Korean chip maker put a knob of butter on each chip, then ran the exact same AI job.
[surprised] Except the last one. Its butter didn't even soften.
[proudly] The maker says its chip runs up to forty degrees cooler, on under five watts.
[deadpan] Critics spotted one thing missing: speed. A cool chip might just be a lazy chip.
[playfully] Would you trust the butter test? Send this to someone whose laptop could fry an egg.
